meta.title: GoECS
meta.description: Test this host or an SSH host and read faithful TXT, HTML, Markdown and JSON reports.

subtitle: A clear view of your machine
concurrentHint: Menu 2 runs all tests concurrently. Performance measurements can affect one another.
sequentialHint: The original program controls execution and section-by-section output.
optionsHint: Options come from the selected engine. Empty values keep its defaults. Presets still use the original menu; explicit values are passed to the engine. Deep stress and device probes require explicit configuration.
noEngine: Download the official engine, or set its absolute path in Settings.
empty: Start a test or open an existing result.
pastebinError: The shared report could not be loaded. Retry, open it in Pastebin, or select Report TXT.
copyFailed: Clipboard is unavailable. Download the report instead.
sidebarHint: When hidden, reopen it from the sidebar More menu.
adminHint: Only the test helper and engine request elevation; DSH stays under your account. Turn this off to run the complete suite without elevation. No prompt appears in CLI/CI.
ask: Ask when a proxy is detected
proxyHint: HTTP/SOCKS does not cover every native TCP, ICMP or route probe. VPN/TUN routes remain controlled by the OS.
binaryHint: On first open, reuse a local executable or verified cache; otherwise download and fill its path automatically. You can also select an existing executable.
name: Name
keyFile: Private key file on the DSH host
fingerprintHint: Verify this fingerprint through a trusted channel. A changed key is never accepted automatically.
adminNotice: The operating system will ask permission to run only the local test helper and GoECS as root / Administrator. DSH does not need to restart. You can also run the complete suite with the current account.
proxyNotice: A proxy is configured on the selected host. Choose the route you intend to test.
privacy: Reports are saved in the plugin data directory. Public upload and share links are enabled by default; turn upload off or enable private mode to disable them.
hostSide: Web tests run on the connected DSH host, not inside the browser.
headless: CLI / CI uses the same backend without loading this page. Select the network route explicitly when a proxy is present.
durationHint: The plugin deadline controls task cleanup. The engine's timeout remains an independent advanced option.
customHint: Custom tests use the original CLI parameters. Preset modes use the original interactive menu.
adminUnavailable: This target cannot show a local authorization dialog. The complete selected suite can run with its current account; individual probes may require root / Administrator.
authorizing: Waiting for operating-system authorization and network preparation…
firewallNotice: Before testing, allow this GoECS executable through Windows Firewall on the currently connected network profiles. The rule applies only to this engine, is removed after the task, and does not override existing block rules.
firewallCurrent: Windows Firewall can still ask permission when a probe first listens for connections. Allow GoECS in that system dialog. Without administrator authorization the plugin cannot prepare the firewall rule in advance.
historyHint: Reports stay in this plugin data directory. Add a remark, open a report, or remove one or several records.
